empirical_qscore_labels <- function(x) {
  parse(text = ifelse(x == 40, "displaystyle(infinity)", as.character(x)))
}

empirical_read_qscore_x_scale <- function() {

  )
}

enlarge_infinity_tick <- function(plot, axis, fontsize = 12.0) {
  axis_name <- switch(axis, x = "axis-b", y = "axis-l")
  grob <- ggplotGrob(plot)
  axis_index <- which(grob$layout$name == axis_name)
  if (length(axis_index) == 0) { return(grob) }
  axis_grob <- grob$grobs[[axis_index]]
  text_grob <- axis_grob$children$axis$grobs[[2]]$children[[1]]
  label_count <- length(text_grob$label)
  if (label_count == 0) { return(grob) }
  text_grob$gp$fontsize <- rep(text_grob$gp$fontsize, label_count)
  text_grob$gp$fontsize[label_count] <- fontsize
  axis_grob$children$axis$grobs[[2]]$children[[1]] <- text_grob
  grob$grobs[[axis_index]] <- axis_grob
  grob
}

}

save_and_crop_figure <- function(filename, plot, height = 160, width = 200) {
  output_dir <- dirname(filename)
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  saved_with_quartz <- FALSE
  if (capabilities("aqua")) {
    saved_with_quartz <- tryCatch(
      {
        grDevices::quartz(
          type = "pdf",
          file = filename,
          width = width / 25.4,
          height = height / 25.4
        )
        print(plot)
        grDevices::dev.off()
        TRUE
      },
      error = function(error) {
        if (grDevices::dev.cur() > 1) {
          grDevices::dev.off()
        }
        message("Quartz PDF device failed; falling back to ggsave(): ", conditionMessage(error))
        FALSE
      }
    )
  }

  if (!saved_with_quartz) {
    ggsave(
      filename, plot,
      height = height, width = width,
      units = "mm", device = "pdf"
    )
  }

  # Trim whitespace from the edges (requires pdfcrop to be available on the CLI)
  pdfcrop <- Sys.which("pdfcrop")
  if (nzchar(pdfcrop)) {
    system2(pdfcrop, c(filename, filename))
  }
}
point_layer <- function(colour) {
  ggrastr::geom_point_rast(
    alpha = 0.05,
    colour = colour,
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.1,
    raster.dpi = 600,
    dev = "ragg"
  )
}

weighted_histogram_rects <- function(
  data, x_column, binwidth = 0.5,
  weight_column = "read_length"
) {
  x_var <- sym(x_column)
  weight_var <- sym(weight_column)
  histogram_data <- data %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[x_column]]), is.finite(.data[[weight_column]]))

  ggplot_build(
    ggplot(histogram_data, aes(x = !!x_var)) +
      geom_histogram(
        aes(weight = !!weight_var),
        binwidth = binwidth,
        position = "identity"
      )
  )$data[[1]] %>%
    filter(y > 0) %>%
    transmute(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = 0,
      ymax = y
    )
}

weighted_histogram_geom <- function(histogram_rects, fill_colour) {
  geom_rect(
    data = histogram_rects,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = fill_colour,
    colour = fill_colour,
    linewidth = 0.02
  )
}

weighted_histogram_layer <- function(
  data, x_column, fill_colour, binwidth = 0.5,
  weight_column = "read_length"
) {
  weighted_histogram_geom(
    weighted_histogram_rects(data, x_column, binwidth = binwidth, weight_column = weight_column),
    fill_colour
  )
}

reference_line <- function() {
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0, y = 0, xend = 40, yend = 40,
    linetype = "dashed", colour = reference_line_colour
  )
}

joint_panel_title <- function(title, title_colour, y, x = 0.8) {
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x,
    y = y,
    label = title,
    hjust = 0.02,
    vjust = 1.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    colour = title_colour
  )
}

make_read_qscore_joint_panel <- function(
  data, histogram_colour, scatter_colour, title, title_colour,
  x_label = "", y_label = ""
) {
  panel_data <- data %>%
    filter(is.finite(empirical_qscore), is.finite(reported_qscore_aligned_region))
  top_histogram_data <- weighted_histogram_rects(
    panel_data, "reported_qscore_aligned_region", weight_column = "aligned_length"
  )

  top_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_geom(top_histogram_data, histogram_colour) +
    reported_read_qscore_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    labs(x = "", y = "", title = title) +
    top_marginal_theme

  scatter <- ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = reported_qscore_aligned_region, y = empirical_qscore)) +
    reference_line() +
    point_layer(scatter_colour) +
    joint_panel_title(title, title_colour, 40.0) +
    reported_read_qscore_x_scale() +
    empirical_read_qscore_y_scale() +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    scatter_panel_theme +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  scatter_grob <- enlarge_infinity_tick(scatter, "y")

  right_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_layer(
      panel_data, "empirical_qscore", histogram_colour, weight_column = "aligned_length"
    ) +
    empirical_read_qscore_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "") +
    right_marginal_theme

  top_grob <- ggplotGrob(top_histogram)
  right_grob <- ggplotGrob(right_histogram)
  top_title <- which(top_grob$layout$name == "title")
  if (length(top_title) == 1) {
    top_grob$grobs[[top_title]] <- grid::nullGrob()
  }

  top_panel <- top_grob$layout[top_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  right_panel <- right_grob$layout[right_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  top_axis_b <- unique(top_grob$layout$t[top_grob$layout$name == "axis-b"])
  right_axis_l <- unique(right_grob$layout$l[right_grob$layout$name == "axis-l"])

  top_grob$widths <- scatter_grob$widths
  right_grob$heights <- scatter_grob$heights

  top_grob$heights[top_axis_b] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")
  right_grob$widths[right_axis_l] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")

  top_grob$heights[top_panel$t] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_top_height, "null")
  right_grob$widths[right_panel$l] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_right_width, "null")

  top_row <- plot_grid(
    top_grob,
    NULL,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  bottom_row <- plot_grid(
    scatter_grob,
    right_grob,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  plot_grid(
    top_row,
    bottom_row,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(joint_marginal_top_height, 1)
  )
}

weighted_sd <- function(x, w) {
  sqrt(weighted.mean((x - weighted.mean(x, w))^2, w))
}

read_accuracy_stats <- data %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    empirical_mean = weighted.mean(
      empirical_qscore_uncapped[aligned & is.finite(empirical_qscore_uncapped)],
      aligned_length[aligned & is.finite(empirical_qscore_uncapped)]
    ),
    empirical_sd = weighted_sd(
      empirical_qscore_uncapped[aligned & is.finite(empirical_qscore_uncapped)],
      aligned_length[aligned & is.finite(empirical_qscore_uncapped)]
    ),
    reported_mean = weighted.mean(reported_qscore_aligned_region[aligned], aligned_length[aligned]),
    reported_sd = weighted_sd(reported_qscore_aligned_region[aligned], aligned_length[aligned]),
    unaligned_reads_percent = 100 * mean(!aligned),
    unaligned_bases_percent = 100 * (1 - sum(aligned_length) / sum(read_length)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(tool, c("Real reads", "Badread", "LongISLND", "lrsim", "NanoSim", "PBSIM3", "SimLoRD")))

three_mer_files <- tribble(
  ~tool,        ~file,                     ~colour,           ~title_colour,
  "Real reads", "results/real.3mer_subs",  real_reads_colour, real_reads_dark,
  "Badread",    "results/badread.3mer_subs", badread_colour, badread_dark,
  "LongISLND",  "results/longislnd.3mer_subs", longislnd_colour, longislnd_dark,
  "lrsim",      "results/lrsim.3mer_subs", lrsim_colour, lrsim_dark,
  "NanoSim",    "results/nanosim.3mer_subs", nanosim_colour, nanosim_dark,
  "PBSIM3",     "results/pbsim3.3mer_subs", pbsim3_colour, pbsim3_dark,
  "SimLoRD",    "results/simlord.3mer_subs", simlord_colour, simlord_dark
)

three_mer_subs <- three_mer_files %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  select(-file) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  mutate(
    substitution = paste(ref_seq, read_seq, sep = "→"),
    tool = factor(tool, levels = three_mer_files$tool)
  )

# Pair all 192 substitution rates with their real-read rates.
three_mer_scatter <- three_mer_subs %>%
  filter(tool != "Real reads") %>%
  left_join(
    three_mer_subs %>%
      filter(tool == "Real reads") %>%
      select(substitution, real_error_rate = error_rate),
    by = "substitution"
  )

# A log scale requires positive rates; flag new zero/missing values rather than silently dropping them.
scatter_rates <- c(three_mer_scatter$real_error_rate, three_mer_scatter$error_rate)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(scatter_rates) & scatter_rates > 0))
scatter_limits <- range(scatter_rates) * c(0.8, 1.25)

three_mer_labels <- three_mer_files %>%
  filter(tool != "Real reads") %>%
  mutate(tool = factor(tool, levels = levels(three_mer_subs$tool)))

figure_2 <- ggplot(three_mer_scatter, aes(x = real_error_rate, y = error_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = reference_line_colour) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = tool), shape = 16, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = three_mer_labels,
    aes(x = scatter_limits[1], y = scatter_limits[2], label = tool, colour = I(title_colour)),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~tool, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(three_mer_files$colour, three_mer_files$tool), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_log10(limits = scatter_limits, breaks = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01), labels = c("0.01%", "0.1%", "1%")) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = scatter_limits, breaks = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01), labels = c("0.01%", "0.1%", "1%")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = "Real-read substitution rate", y = "Simulated substitution rate") +
  scatter_panel_theme +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

save_and_crop_figure("figures/figure_2.pdf", figure_2, height = 110, width = 180)

figure_2

per_base <- files %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  mutate(
    all_errors   = mismatch + insertion + deletion/2,
    total        = all_errors + match,
    error_rate   = all_errors / total,
    error_qscore = -10 * log10(error_rate)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total) & total > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    tool = factor(
      tool,
      levels = c("Real reads", setdiff(unique(tool), "Real reads"))
    )
  )

per_base$error_qscore <- pmin(per_base$error_qscore, 60)  # set infinities to 60

)

homopolymer_mae <- homopolymer_pairs %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    homopolymer_mae_pp = 100 * mean(abs(error_rate - real_error_rate)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
weighted_wasserstein <- function(x, y, x_weights, y_weights) {
  stopifnot(
    length(x) == length(x_weights), length(y) == length(y_weights),
    all(is.finite(x)), all(is.finite(y)),
    all(is.finite(x_weights)), all(is.finite(y_weights)),
    all(x_weights >= 0), all(y_weights >= 0),
    sum(x_weights) > 0, sum(y_weights) > 0
  )
  values <- c(x, y)
  mass_difference <- c(x_weights / sum(x_weights), -y_weights / sum(y_weights))
  order_index <- order(values)
  cdf_difference <- cumsum(mass_difference[order_index])
  sum(diff(values[order_index]) * abs(head(cdf_difference, -1)))
}

real_aligned <- df_Real_reads %>% filter(aligned)
real_empirical <- real_aligned %>% filter(is.finite(empirical_qscore_uncapped))

wasserstein_stats <- map_dfr(
  c("Badread", "LongISLND", "lrsim", "NanoSim", "PBSIM3", "SimLoRD"),
  function(tool_name) {
    reads <- data %>% filter(tool == tool_name)
    aligned_reads <- reads %>% filter(aligned)
    empirical_reads <- aligned_reads %>% filter(is.finite(empirical_qscore_uncapped))
    bases <- per_base %>% filter(tool == tool_name)

    tibble(
      tool = tool_name,
      read_length_bp = weighted_wasserstein(
        reads$read_length, df_Real_reads$read_length,
        reads$read_length, df_Real_reads$read_length
      ),
      empirical_qscore = weighted_wasserstein(
        empirical_reads$empirical_qscore_uncapped, real_empirical$empirical_qscore_uncapped,
        empirical_reads$aligned_length, real_empirical$aligned_length
      ),
      reported_qscore = weighted_wasserstein(
        aligned_reads$reported_qscore_aligned_region, real_aligned$reported_qscore_aligned_region,
        aligned_reads$aligned_length, real_aligned$aligned_length
      ),
      correct_base_qscore = weighted_wasserstein(
        bases$qscore, per_base_real$qscore, bases$match, per_base_real$match
      ),
      error_base_qscore = weighted_wasserstein(
        bases$qscore, per_base_real$qscore, bases$all_errors, per_base_real$all_errors
      )
    )
  }
)

  filter(rlen <= 9) %>%
  mutate(
    error_rate = 1 - ATGC,

      str_starts(tool, "pbsim3_hp_") ~ "PBSIM3"
    ),
    setting = as.numeric(str_extract(tool, "[0-9]+$")),
    title = case_when(
      tool == "real" ~ "Real reads",
      tool == "nanosim_hp_off" ~ "NanoSim: homopolymer modelling off",
      simulator == "NanoSim" ~ paste0("NanoSim: --min_homopolymer_len ", setting),
      tool == "pbsim3_hp_1" ~ "PBSIM3: --hp-del-bias 1 (default)",
      simulator == "PBSIM3" ~ paste0("PBSIM3: --hp-del-bias ", setting)
    )

make_homopolymer_mode_plot <- function(tool, simulator, title, colour, outline, starshape) {
  panel_data <- homopolymer_modes_data %>% filter(.data$tool == .env$tool)

  ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = rlen, y = error_rate)) +
    geom_line(colour = colour, linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggstar::geom_star(
      starshape = starshape, fill = colour, colour = outline,
      size = 2.5, starstroke = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = homopolymer_mode_x_limits,
      breaks = seq(homopolymer_mode_x_limits[1], homopolymer_mode_x_limits[2]),
      minor_breaks = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, homopolymer_mode_y_max),
      breaks = seq(0, homopolymer_mode_y_max, 0.1),
      expand = c(0, 0), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1.0)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (tool == "real") "Homopolymer length" else NULL,
      y = if (tool == "real") "Error rate" else NULL,
      title = title
    ) +
    scatter_panel_theme +
    coloured_title_theme(outline) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(5.5, 8, 5.5, 5.5))
}

make_homopolymer_mode_grid <- function(plots) {
  # The first plot is real reads; keep it one panel high in its own column.
  simulator_plots <- plots[-1]
  simulator_rows <- ceiling(length(simulator_plots) / 2)
  real_column <- ggdraw() + draw_plot(
    plots[[1]], y = (1 - 1 / simulator_rows) / 2,
    height = 1 / simulator_rows
  )
  simulator_grid <- plot_grid(
    plotlist = simulator_plots, ncol = 2, align = "hv", axis = "tblr"
  )
  plot_grid(real_column, simulator_grid, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 2))
}

    geom_col(fill = colour, colour = colour, width = 1, linewidth = 0.02) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label, title = title) +
    supplementary_qscore_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    plot_theme +
    coloured_title_theme(title_colour)
}

per_base_calibration_plot <- function(data, colour, title, title_colour, x_label = "", y_label = "", plot_theme) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = qscore, y = error_qscore)) +
    geom_segment(
      x = 0, y = 0, xend = 60, yend = 60,
      linetype = "dashed", colour = reference_line_colour
    ) +
    geom_point(colour = colour, alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5, shape = 16) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label, title = title) +
    supplementary_qscore_x_scale() +
    supplementary_empirical_base_qscore_y_scale() +
    plot_theme +
    coloured_title_theme(title_colour)
}

assembler_shapes <- c(flye = 15, metamdbg = 13, miniasm = 28, myloasm = 11, raven = 23)
assembler_labels <- c("Flye", "metaMDBG", "miniasm", "myloasm", "Raven")

assembly_points <- read_tsv("results/assemblies.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(identity_trimmed)) %>%
  filter(assembler != "autocycler") %>%
  mutate(
    depth = as.integer(depth),
    assembler = factor(assembler, levels = names(assembler_shapes)),
    tool = recode(sim_tool, "real" = "Real reads", "badread" = "Badread",
                  "longislnd" = "LongISLND", "nanosim" = "NanoSim",
                  "pbsim3" = "PBSIM3", "simlord" = "SimLoRD"),
    tool = factor(tool, levels = names(homopolymer_colours))
  )

# Linear through Q60, then smoothly approach position 65 as Q approaches infinity.
# The Q60-to-infinity interval is half the spacing of the other ticks.
assembly_identity_transform <- new_transform(
  "assembly_identity",
  transform = function(identity) {
    q <- -10 * log10(1 - identity)
    high <- !is.na(q) & q > 60
    q[high] <- 65 - 5 * exp(-(q[high] - 60) / 5)
    q
  },
  inverse = function(y) {
    high <- !is.na(y) & y > 60
    y[high] <- 60 - 5 * log(pmax(0, (65 - y[high]) / 5))
    1 - 10^(-y / 10)
  },
  domain = c(0, 1)
)

assembly_identity_panel <- function(tool_name) {
  panel_data <- assembly_points %>% filter(tool == tool_name)
  colour <- unname(homopolymer_colours[tool_name])
  outline <- unname(homopolymer_outline_colours[tool_name])
  ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = depth, y = identity_trimmed)) +
    ggstar::geom_star(
      aes(starshape = assembler, fill = complete),
      colour = outline, size = 2, starstroke = 0.7
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = colour, "FALSE" = NA_character_), guide = "none") +
    scale_starshape_manual(values = assembler_shapes, labels = assembler_labels,
                           name = "Assembler", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50), breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), minor_breaks = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      transform = assembly_identity_transform,
      limits = c(1 - 10^(-20 / 10), 1), breaks = 1 - 10^(-c(20, 30, 40, 50, 60, Inf) / 10),
      labels = expression(20, 30, 40, 50, 60, infinity),
      minor_breaks = NULL, expand = expansion(add = c(2.5, 2.5))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = tool_name,
      x = if (tool_name == "Real reads") "Read depth" else "",
      y = if (tool_name == "Real reads") "Assembly Q-score" else ""
    ) +
    scatter_panel_theme +
    coloured_title_theme(outline) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

assembly_panels <- setNames(lapply(names(homopolymer_colours), assembly_identity_panel),
                           names(homopolymer_colours))
assembly_panel_grobs <- lapply(assembly_panels, enlarge_infinity_tick, axis = "y")
assembly_legend <- get_plot_component(
  assembly_panels[["Real reads"]] +
    theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = grid::unit(4, "mm")) +
    guides(starshape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey70", colour = "grey20", size = 2.2))),
  "guide-box-right"
)
figure_s7 <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = list(
    NULL, assembly_panel_grobs[["Badread"]], assembly_panel_grobs[["LongISLND"]],
    assembly_panel_grobs[["Real reads"]], assembly_panel_grobs[["lrsim"]], assembly_panel_grobs[["NanoSim"]],
    ggdraw(assembly_legend), assembly_panel_grobs[["PBSIM3"]], assembly_panel_grobs[["SimLoRD"]]
  ),
  ncol = 3, align = "hv", axis = "tblr"
)

make_read_length_qscore_joint_panel <- function(
  data, qscore_column, histogram_colour, scatter_colour, title, title_colour,
  qscore_x_scale, qscore_y_scale, title_y, x_label = "", y_label = ""
) {
  panel_data <- data %>%
    filter(is.finite(read_length), is.finite(.data[[qscore_column]]))
  top_histogram_data <- weighted_histogram_rects(
    panel_data, "read_length", binwidth = 1000
  )

  top_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_geom(top_histogram_data, histogram_colour) +
    read_length_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    labs(x = "", y = "", title = title) +
    top_marginal_theme

  scatter <- ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = read_length, y = .data[[qscore_column]])) +
    point_layer(scatter_colour) +
    joint_panel_title(title, title_colour, y = title_y, x = 1200) +
    read_length_x_scale() +
    qscore_y_scale() +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    scatter_panel_theme +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

  scatter_grob <- ggplotGrob(scatter)
  if (identical(qscore_column, "empirical_qscore")) {
    scatter_grob <- enlarge_infinity_tick(scatter, "y")
  }

  right_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_layer(panel_data, qscore_column, histogram_colour) +
    qscore_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "") +
    right_marginal_theme

  top_grob <- ggplotGrob(top_histogram)
  right_grob <- ggplotGrob(right_histogram)
  top_title <- which(top_grob$layout$name == "title")
  if (length(top_title) == 1) {
    top_grob$grobs[[top_title]] <- grid::nullGrob()
  }

  top_panel <- top_grob$layout[top_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  right_panel <- right_grob$layout[right_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  top_axis_b <- unique(top_grob$layout$t[top_grob$layout$name == "axis-b"])
  right_axis_l <- unique(right_grob$layout$l[right_grob$layout$name == "axis-l"])

  top_grob$widths <- scatter_grob$widths
  right_grob$heights <- scatter_grob$heights

  top_grob$heights[top_axis_b] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")
  right_grob$widths[right_axis_l] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")

  top_grob$heights[top_panel$t] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_top_height, "null")
  right_grob$widths[right_panel$l] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_right_width, "null")

  top_row <- plot_grid(
    top_grob,
    NULL,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  bottom_row <- plot_grid(
    scatter_grob,
    right_grob,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  plot_grid(
    top_row,
    bottom_row,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(joint_marginal_top_height, 1)
  )
}
